author: vladimir_ea
content:
currently all nodes are supposed to gossip 2 attestation subnets, which with PQ would be roughly 1MB in and out per slot (or slightly less) x7 or so for gossip amplification.

7MB is 56Mbit. These don't arrive all at once, currently the majority typically arrive across 2-3s. 

So its conceivable that the bandwidth constraints will cause delays at least.

author: kevaundray
content:
A full node and a staking machine have different latency and resource requirements so they would have different minimums (this is why 7870 also separated the two) 

I don’t expect a normal full node to care about things like the intermediate aggregates that happen during consensus
